name: Simon
summary: A sorcerer in Samaria who had amazed the people, until he believed and was baptized when Philip preached. When he offered money for the power to give the Holy Ghost, Peter rebuked him.

key_moments.title: Believes and Is Baptized
key_moments.description: Simon had long amazed the people of Samaria with sorcery, and they said he was God's great power. When Philip preached, Simon believed too, was baptized, and stayed close to Philip, amazed at the miracles.

key_moments.title: Trying to Buy God's Gift
key_moments.description: When Simon saw the Holy Ghost given as the apostles laid on their hands, he offered them money for that power. Peter told him God's gift could not be bought with money and that he must repent, and Simon asked them to pray for him.
